parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: A sine curve through $(0,2)$ and $(2\pi,2)$, with maximum $(\frac\pi2,5)$ and minimum $(\frac{3\pi}2,-1)$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Fully correct curve, including 2, 5 and $-1$ clearly labelled or implied on the $y$-axis and horizontal only at $(\frac\pi2,5)$ and $(\frac{3\pi}2,-1)$ approximately — B2,1,0. Condone intercepts/stationary points not exactly positioned and axes not to scale. B1 for one full cycle from 0 to $2\pi$, starting on the positive $y$-axis and initially increasing. Starting at the origin or finishing at $(2\pi,0)$ scores B0. Total 2.
